annotations.title: Search World Bank, UNGM, UNDP & EU TED Tenders

description: Search live multilateral procurement tenders, RFPs, EOIs, and contract awards (including winning suppliers and award prices) across World Bank, UNGM (32+ UN Agencies), UNDP, and EU TED (`corridordata/multilateral-development-tenders`).

maxItems.description: Maximum procurement or contract-award notices to return.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Optional per-run USD spend cap forwarded to Apify Pay-Per-Event billing (`maxTotalChargeUsd`).

recordMode.description: Return open bidding opportunities, awarded contracts, or all notices.

sources.description: Multilateral portals to query in parallel (defaults to all 4).

name: search_global_tenders
